name: aspect-ratio
useFor: Wrap an aerial or photo in AspectRatio with ratio={16 / 9} (or 4 / 3, 1) so it keeps its shape at every width, and clip it with overflow-hidden. Dim it with ds-imagery when marks or a parcel outline sit on top, so the marks read first.
constraints: Stock photos where a place is not shown
source: Brand principles: real photos only as accents, where a place needs to be shown; ds-imagery from brand/utilities.css
title: Aspect Ratio
description: A frame that holds an aerial, a map tile or a site photo at a fixed shape, square-cornered.
